benchmark.title: Modern IR Bench
benchmark.notice: Scores are rebuilt from versioned result evidence. Open a Solution for its method notes, code, and provenance.

tasks.title: Modern IR PDF Retrieval v1
tasks.description: Retrieve whole PDF documents from bilingual queries across generated layouts, scans, screenshots, annotations, compression, and camera-capture conditions.

tasks.title: Modern IR Ranked Retrieval v2.2
tasks.description: Bilingual synthetic retrieval with independent Chinese and English candidate pools and an expanded binary relevance set.

solutions.title: BGE-M3 dense · 768-token chunks
solutions.description: Pinned BGE-M3 dense embeddings over shared chunks with Milvus FLAT search.
solutions.readme_preview: The dense and learned-sparse Solutions share one pinned BGE-M3 encoder at revision 5617a9f61b028005a4858fdac845db406aefb181. They use the model's dedicated corpus and query encoding paths and reproduce both vector families from the same inference pass.

solutions.title: BGE-M3 dense + sparse · RRF
solutions.description: Fuse the native BGE-M3 dense and learned-sparse Top-50 rankings with RRF.
solutions.readme_preview: BGE-M3 exposes dense and learned-sparse representations from the same multilingual model. This Solution retrieves the shared 768-token chunks independently with both representations, collapses chunk hits to whole-document rankings, and fuses the two Top-50 lists.

solutions.title: BGE-M3 learned sparse · 768-token chunks
solutions.description: Pinned BGE-M3 learned-sparse vectors over shared chunks with Milvus search.
solutions.readme_preview: The dense and learned-sparse Solutions share one pinned BGE-M3 encoder at revision 5617a9f61b028005a4858fdac845db406aefb181. They use the model's dedicated corpus and query encoding paths and reproduce both vector families from the same inference pass.

solutions.title: BM25 · 768-token chunks
solutions.description: Milvus BM25 over shared chunks, collapsed to document rankings.
solutions.readme_preview: The full-document and chunked BM25 Solutions use Milvus built-in BM25 with an English analyzer for English pools and a Chinese analyzer for Chinese pools. The Task keeps the two language candidate pools independent.

solutions.title: BM25 · full document
solutions.description: Milvus BM25 over full documents with language-specific analyzers.
solutions.readme_preview: The full-document and chunked BM25 Solutions use Milvus built-in BM25 with an English analyzer for English pools and a Chinese analyzer for Chinese pools. The Task keeps the two language candidate pools independent.

solutions.title: BM25 + GTE sparse · RRF
solutions.description: Fuse BM25 and GTE Multilingual Base learned-sparse Top-50 rankings with RRF.
solutions.readme_preview: This Solution tests whether GTE Multilingual Base neural lexical expansion contributes complementary candidates beyond classic BM25 over the same 768-token chunks.

solutions.title: BM25 + Qwen3 Embedding 8B · RRF
solutions.description: Fuse BM25 and Qwen3 Embedding 8B Top-50 document rankings with equal-weight RRF.
solutions.readme_preview: This hybrid Solution prepares the shared 768-token chunks twice: Milvus BM25 provides lexical ranks and Qwen3 Embedding 8B provides dense semantic ranks. For each query it retrieves the Top 50 documents from both components and fuses them with equal-weight reciprocal rank fusion using a rank constant of 60.

solutions.title: BM25 + Qwen3 Embedding 8B · Weighted 25/75
solutions.description: Fuse min-max normalized BM25 and Qwen3 Embedding 8B Top-50 scores with 25/75 weights.
solutions.readme_title: BM25 + Qwen3 Embedding 8B · Weighted score fusion
solutions.readme_preview: This hybrid family retrieves the Top 50 documents independently with Milvus BM25 and Qwen3 Embedding 8B over the shared 768-token chunks. Within each query, the two score lists are independently min-max normalized and then combined with fixed BM25/dense weights. Milvus exposes its BM25 relevance as a distance where lower values rank first, while cosine similarity ranks higher values first; the normalization preserves those respective directions.

solutions.title: BM25 + Qwen3 Weighted → BGE Reranker v2 M3
solutions.description: Rerank weighted BM25/Qwen3 Top-50 candidates as complete documents with BGE Reranker v2 M3.
solutions.readme_preview: This self-hosted two-stage family first retrieves 50 document candidates, then scores every query-document pair with the pinned multilingual BAAI/bge-reranker-v2-m3 cross-encoder. The highest ten scores become the submitted ranking.

solutions.title: BM25 + Qwen3 Weighted → Cohere Rerank 4 Pro
solutions.description: Rerank weighted BM25/Qwen3 Top-50 candidates as complete documents with Cohere Rerank 4 Pro.
solutions.readme_preview: Cohere Rerank 4 Pro reranks 50 complete-document candidates from the maintained BM25/Qwen3 weighted hybrid through OpenRouter, then returns the ten highest-scoring document IDs.

solutions.title: BM25 + Qwen3 Weighted → Voyage Rerank 3
solutions.description: Rerank weighted BM25/Qwen3 Top-50 candidates as complete documents with Voyage Rerank 3.
solutions.readme_preview: This two-stage family first retrieves 50 document candidates, then sends each query and the complete candidate documents to Voyage rerank-3. The returned relevance scores replace the first-stage order; the best ten documents become the submitted ranking.

solutions.title: BM25 + Voyage 4 Large · RRF
solutions.description: Fuse BM25 and Voyage 4 Large Top-50 document rankings with equal-weight RRF.
solutions.readme_preview: This hybrid retrieves the shared 768-token chunks independently with BM25 and Voyage 4 Large, then collapses each branch to a Top-50 whole-document ranking. Voyage document and query embeddings use the official Voyage API at 1024 dimensions.

solutions.title: DashScope Text Embedding v4 · 768-token chunks
solutions.description: DashScope Text Embedding v4 over shared chunks with native query/document modes and Milvus FLAT search.
solutions.readme_preview: DashScope Text Embedding v4 embeds the shared 768-token chunks through Alibaba Cloud Model Studio's native API and retrieves them with exact cosine search in Milvus before collapsing hits to whole documents.

solutions.title: EmbeddingGemma 2 · 768-token chunks
solutions.description: Pinned local text-only EmbeddingGemma 2 over shared chunks with Milvus FLAT search.
solutions.readme_preview: This lightweight local dense Solution pins google/embeddinggemma-2 to revision 914f7f89142e33e77833254d9c9b90c3cef7303b. Only its text encoder is loaded. Queries and documents use the model's SearchQuery and Document prompt routes, then Milvus performs exact cosine search over 768-dimensional vectors generated from the benchmark-wide shared chunks.

solutions.title: EmbeddingGemma 2 · page images
solutions.description: Render PDF pages as images, retrieve them with local EmbeddingGemma 2, then collapse to documents.
solutions.readme_preview: This OCR-free visual Solution pins google/embeddinggemma-2 to revision 914f7f89142e33e77833254d9c9b90c3cef7303b. It loads the text and vision encoders, renders every PDF page with the benchmark's shared renderer, embeds page images, and embeds queries with the model's SearchQuery prompt route. Milvus performs exact cosine search over 768-dimensional vectors, after which page hits are collapsed to whole-document rankings.

solutions.title: Gemini Embedding 2 · 768-token chunks
solutions.description: Gemini Embedding 2 over shared chunks with Milvus FLAT search.
solutions.readme_preview: This managed dense Solution uses google/gemini-embedding-2 through OpenRouter. Documents and queries use the API's search_document and search_query input types, respectively. Documents use the benchmark-wide 768-token chunks, and Milvus performs exact cosine search over native 3072-dimensional vectors.

solutions.title: Gemini Embedding 2 · page images
solutions.description: Render PDF pages as images, retrieve them with Gemini Embedding 2, then collapse to documents.
solutions.readme_preview: This OCR-free visual Solution renders each PDF page with the benchmark's shared renderer and sends page images to google/gemini-embedding-2 through OpenRouter. Text queries and page images share one native 3072-dimensional space. Milvus performs exact cosine search over pages before page hits are collapsed to unique document rankings.

solutions.title: Granite Embedding 30M Sparse · 768-token chunks
solutions.description: IBM's lightweight 30M English sparse bi-encoder over the shared bilingual corpus.
solutions.readme_preview: This Solution pins IBM's 30M-parameter English sparse bi-encoder as a deliberately small learned-sparse baseline. It generates weighted vocabulary expansions for both queries and documents and uses the checkpoint's native 512-token limit.

solutions.title: GTE Multilingual Base sparse · 768-token chunks
solutions.description: The learned lexical-weight branch of GTE Multilingual Base over the shared chunks.
solutions.readme_preview: This Solution uses the sparse token-weight output of the pinned 304M GTE Multilingual Base checkpoint. It applies the checkpoint's learned non-negative weight to each input token, keeps the strongest weight for repeated vocabulary IDs, and evaluates Chinese and English with the same model.

solutions.title: GTE sparse + Qwen3 Embedding 8B · RRF
solutions.description: Fuse GTE learned-sparse and Qwen3 Embedding 8B Top-50 rankings with RRF.
solutions.readme_preview: This Solution combines the multilingual lexical weights from GTE Multilingual Base with dense Qwen3 Embedding 8B retrieval. Both branches search the same 768-token chunks and contribute a Top-50 whole-document ranking.

solutions.title: Jina Embeddings v5 Text Small · 768-token chunks
solutions.description: Jina Embeddings v5 Text Small over shared chunks with Milvus FLAT search.
solutions.readme_preview: Jina Embeddings v5 Text Small embeds the shared 768-token chunks through the Jina API, distinguishes retrieval passages from retrieval queries, and retrieves chunk vectors with exact cosine search in Milvus before collapsing hits to whole documents.

solutions.title: Llama Nemotron Embed VL 1B V2 · page images
solutions.description: Render PDF pages as images, retrieve them with Llama Nemotron Embed VL 1B V2, then collapse to documents.
solutions.readme_title: Llama Nemotron Embed VL 1B V2 · page images
solutions.readme_preview: This OCR-free visual Solution renders each PDF page with the benchmark's shared renderer and sends page images to nvidia/llama-nemotron-embed-vl-1b-v2:free through OpenRouter. Text queries and page images share one native 2048-dimensional space. Milvus performs exact cosine search over pages before page hits are collapsed to unique document rankings.

solutions.title: Mistral Embed 2312 · 768-token chunks
solutions.description: Mistral Embed 2312 over shared chunks with Milvus FLAT search.
solutions.readme_preview: Mistral Embed 2312 embeds the shared 768-token chunks through OpenRouter and retrieves 1,024-dimensional vectors with exact cosine search in Milvus before collapsing hits to whole documents.

solutions.title: OpenSearch v2 Distill doc-only sparse · 768-token chunks
solutions.description: A compact English doc-only neural sparse model with static query encoding.
solutions.readme_preview: This Solution pins OpenSearch's compact English v2-distill document encoder. Documents receive neural sparse expansions, while queries use the checkpoint's static sparse encoder. The English-only model is intentionally evaluated on both language slices.

solutions.title: OpenSearch Multilingual v1 sparse · 768-token chunks
solutions.description: A 160M multilingual learned-sparse model with static query encoding and neural document expansion.
solutions.readme_preview: This Solution pins OpenSearch's 160M multilingual learned-sparse model and encodes the shared 768-token chunks into weighted vocabulary entries. Query encoding uses the model's static token-weight route, while document encoding performs neural expansion. Both Chinese and English are evaluated in the same bilingual release.

solutions.title: Ovis Omni Embedding 3B · page images
solutions.description: Render PDF pages as images, retrieve them with local Ovis Omni Embedding 3B, then collapse to documents.
solutions.readme_preview: This self-hosted visual Solution uses the pinned Apache-2.0 ATH-MaaS/Ovis-Omni-Embedding-3B checkpoint. It follows the model's native Qwen2.5-Omni processor and chat template, removes the unused language-modeling head and audio tower after loading, takes the last non-padding hidden state, and L2-normalizes the resulting native 2048-dimensional vector.

solutions.title: PP-OCRv5 Mobile + BGE-M3 · full document
solutions.description: OCR every page, embed each complete document with local BGE-M3, then search with Milvus FLAT.
solutions.readme_preview: This is the local dense counterpart to the OCR + BM25 baseline.

solutions.title: PP-OCRv5 Mobile + BM25/BGE-M3 · RRF
solutions.description: OCR every page, fuse full-document BM25 and BGE-M3 Top-50 rankings with equal-weight RRF.
solutions.readme_preview: This local hybrid uses one OCR representation and two complementary retrieval methods.

solutions.title: PP-OCRv5 Mobile + BM25 · full document
solutions.description: OCR every PDF page with a small bilingual model, then run language-aware Milvus BM25.
solutions.readme_preview: This Solution is the simple OCR baseline for the PDF Retrieval Task.
